title: Environmental Impact of Relocation and Redevelopment of Paya Lebar Airbase
what_it_is: Environmental Impact of Relocation and Redevelopment of Paya Lebar Airbase

sections.label: Paya Lebar Airbase redevelopment studies
sections.summary: Paya Lebar Airbase redevelopment starts from the 2030s, with environmental studies and mitigation measures, and safeguarded green spaces at Sungei Serangoon.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The redevelopment of Paya Lebar Airbase will only commence from the 2030s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Prior to that, we will evaluate the potential impact on the environment and biodiversity in the area and conduct more detailed environmental studies if the impact is assessed to be significant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These studies will also inform mitigation measures for the redevelopment, including the integration of green spaces in and around Paya Lebar Airbase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For Sungei Serangoon, a network of parks and park connectors has been safeguarded to enhance green spaces for biodiversity as well as provide recreational spaces for the community.

sections.label: Progressive site development timeline
sections.summary: The site will be developed progressively over several decades after the airbase relocation from the 2030s.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The site will be developed progressively over several decades after the relocation of the airbase from the 2030s.

sections.label: Sungei Serangoon banks development plans
sections.summary: Eastern bank vegetated areas are zoned B2 industrial with no near-term redevelopment, while the western bank park connector may extend east from 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Most of the vegetated areas along Sungei Serangoon are located on the eastern bank, which is currently zoned for B2 industrial use and there are no plans to launch the area for redevelopment in the near term, except for an industrial cluster in the vicinity of the upcoming Defu station on the Cross Island Line.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Actually, more importantly, most of the areas on the western bank of Sungei Serangoon have already been developed with an existing park connector running along the western bank from Tampines Road to Punggol Promenade.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And to enhance the connector area, URA is working with the National Parks Board (NParks) to see how we can continue to build on that, potentially extending the park connector along the eastern bank from 2025.

sections.label: Sungei Serangoon eastern bank assurance
sections.summary: Most vegetated areas on Sungei Serangoon's eastern bank are zoned B2 industrial and there are no near-term plans to launch development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I am very glad to hear that the residents enjoy the park connectors and green spaces that are available along Sungei Serangoon.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: These are considerations that we will factor into the planning and I just want to assure the Member by reiterating what I said just now that most of the vegetated areas around Sungei Serangoon on the eastern bank are currently rezoned for B2 industrial use and there are no plans to launch the area for development in the near term.
